item.title: Vietnam: Technology and Innovation Power Sustainable Growth
item.description: Vietnam in 2025 positions science, technology, innovation and digital transformation as central pillars to drive sustainable growth, economic development, social progress and a modern, knowledge-based economy.

item.title: Hong Kong: Simplifying Global Tech Talent Access for Growth
item.description: Hong Kong enhances its talent admission scheme to speed recruitment for research and development, widen eligible fields and support innovation park tenants.

item.title: India: CSIR Labs Propelling India’s Technological Leadership
item.description: Dr Jitendra Singh highlighted CSIR laboratories’ pivotal role in accelerating technology transfer, fostering industry collaboration and driving India’s innovation-led industrial, technological and societal growth nationwide.

item.title: Singapore: AI and Tech Sectors Power 2025 GDP Momentum
item.description: Singapore’s 2025 economic growth outperformed expectations, driven by AI-related electronics, ICT services, digital innovation and tech-enabled manufacturing, financial, enterprise and emerging sectors.

item.title: Malaysia: Strengthening Digital Infrastructure for a Connected Future
item.description: Malaysia strengthens its digital infrastructure and policy environment, driving nationwide connectivity, 5G adoption and tech-enabled services to boost economic growth and digital inclusion.

item.title: The Philippines: LGUSS-BIMS Powers Local Government Digitalisation
item.description: The Philippines is digitally transforming barangays through LGUSS-BIMS, enhancing efficiency, transparency and citizen governance while empowering local communities with data-driven services.

item.title: Australia: Bandit System Showcases Next-Gen EW Technology
item.description: Stormforce 25 demonstrated the debut of the Bandit system, highlighting agile, interoperable electronic operations and coalition collaboration through advanced, data-driven, operator-focused technologies.

item.title: India: AI and Technology Revolutionising Rail Travel Experience
item.description: Indian Railways is steadily embedding AI, digital platforms, and indigenous technology across all railway operations and stations to enhance overall safety, efficiency and passenger services nationwide.

item.title: Hong Kong: iAM Smart Enhances Unified Digital Government Services
item.description: Hong Kong’s iAM Smart platform, now with over four million users, centralises public services through secure, personalised and mobile-friendly digital access, advancing the city’s smart strategy.

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Literacy for All Vital for a Digital Future
item.description: Vietnam’s “Digital literacy for all” movement is equipping citizens nationwide with essential digital skills to enable inclusive participation in digital services, support innovation and advance national digital transformation.
